subject: MAP: finalize staging environment and close runbook
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chang <olivia@medflow.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: initial checklist for staging env and next steps

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the sync earlier. Per our mutual action plan, I’m lining up the items we need from your side to get the POC staging environment ready and stay on the target close cadence the week of Oct 11. High-level checklist below — please confirm owners and ETA for each item: 

1) Org setup: A service admin for your org (email) so we can create the demo org and invite read-only observers. Owner: MedFlow SID?
2) API keys: We’ll issue a scoped demo key, but need confirmation on any IP restrictions you require.
3) IP allowlist: Please share expected egress CIDR blocks for your firewalls and any inbound ranges (if you want to restrict calls to our hosted endpoints).
4) VPC peering: Cloud account IDs, desired peering window (we have an infra change freeze Oct 7 — prefer Oct 5–6).
5) Compliance materials: SOC2 evidence request items (if applicable) — we’ll attach a minimal set for the POC.

I attached the MAP-draft-v3.xlsx that maps owners and dates. Can you confirm the CIDRs and primary contact for network ops by EOD Monday (Oct 4)? If MedFlow is OK with the Oct 5 peering window we’ll kick the INFRA ticket.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v3.xlsx

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Olivia Chang <olivia@medflow.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Keller <tim.keller@enterprisemed.io>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 10:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: initial checklist for staging env and next steps

Ben —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers from our side: 

- Org setup: Use staging-admin@medflow.co (I’ve created the identity and added Tim as backup).
- API keys/IP allowlist: Our security team requires inbound restriction to the following CIDRs for egress from our VPC to Redwood endpoints: 34.192.0.0/14, 52.28.0.0/15. For the demo, we can allow 3 hour maintenance windows if you need transient exceptions.
- VPC peering: Cloud account ID (AWS): 123456789012. Tim will coordinate the peering request with you. Preferred window: Oct 5 (we can also do Oct 6 morning).
- Compliance: We don’t need full SOC2 for the POC, but we will expect audit logs access for the demo sessions.

I’ve looped Tim (network lead) for the peering setup. Attaching our internal diagram; see inline note on routing.

On Monday we’ll confirm final firewall rules and share a contact for the network ticket.

—Olivia
Olivia Chang
Director of Integrations, MedFlow Health
olivia@medflow.co | +1 (617) 555-1290

On Fri, Oct 1, 2027 at 09:12 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message trimmed)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: medflow MAP - action items post-confirmation

Marissa / Hannah —

Olivia confirmed CIDRs and gave a peering window for Oct 5. Please action the following: 

- Marissa: open INFRA ticket for VPC peering (AWS acct 123456789012) and reference JIRA INFRA-4821. Attach peering-request-aws.json and request a TTL for route propagation test. Owner: Marissa.
- Hannah: prepare a scoped demo API key (demo-staging-medflow) with the following limits: 100k tokens/day, read-only access to their org, and include a short expiry (30 days). Drop the key as demo-api-key-sample.txt in Drive and mark it "for test only". Owner: Hannah.
- Ben: I’ll follow up with MedFlow to confirm the exact maintenance window and verify firewall acceptance.

Target: Peering established and demo key handed to Olivia by EOD Oct 5 so we can run smoke tests Oct 6.

Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: medflow MAP - action items post-confirmation

Ben —

INFRA ticket created: https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/INFRA-4821 (assigned to netops). I attached the peering-request-aws.json payload I submitted to the ticket and requested a peering test window of Oct 5 14:00–16:00 PDT. Netops asked for a verification CIDR we can ping from our side after routes propagate.

Also reserved a small burst slot on Dedicated for Oct 6 smoke tests (reserved pool id: ded-72). If netops needs further permissions for MedFlow’s account, they’ll reach out to Tim.

Attachments: peering-request-aws.json

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Olivia Chang <olivia@medflow.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Keller <tim.keller@enterprisemed.io>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: finalize staging environment and close runbook

Ben / Marissa —

Quick update from our end: NetOps completed the peering acceptance this afternoon and confirmed that route propagation completed at ~16:25 PDT. Tim verified connectivity by pinging 34.192.1.10 and the handshake passed. We received the demo API key in a secure note — worked through a quick token fetch and successful sample call to the /v1/encode endpoint (response latency within expected range).

Next steps:
- We’ll run a short integration smoke test Wednesday morning Oct 6 (08:30 ET) and share results.
- If tests pass, let’s agree to close the MAP and move to a 2-week proof-of-value where we collect performance telemetry.

Thanks for the fast turnaround — Olivia

Attachments: demo-api-key-sample.txt (delivered securely)
